svg.text: Content Factory as a digital marketing agency
Plumbing → Produce → Process → Post → Promote → Perform / MAA · Local Service Spotlight
Work is still divided across the named desks. Muse on Spark does high-volume non-frontier work:
Google/Meta errands, inbox, calendar, bookings, watch-and-ping, volume monitoring.
Astra (Dot + specific ChatGPT tasks) does the thinking — and Dot is experimental.
As there are many Dots, the models absorb the harness.
Fewer humans need to divide the work and project-manage the handoffs.
The locked line does not change. Do not retire a desk because this note exists.
Muse on Spark — volume lane (cost order 2)
Inbox, calendar, bookings, Google Photos/Docs/Gmail, Meta (FB/IG/WA/Threads), watch-and-ping, volume monitoring. Not frontier reasoning. Local Qwen
(free) comes first for offline bulk text that can wait for a Mac.
Hard research, strategy/judgment drafts, definitive-article reasoning, MAA analysis that must be right, code/docs that matter. Spot-check Dot; on
critical work a human or a fresh ChatGPT task checks it before anyone acts.
Swimlanes — each badge is a named seat. Gold arrows are handoffs. Nothing public or paid without Dennis.
Cheapest capable: Muse for Google logins
No public/paid gate in this station
Cheapest capable: Qwen bulk · Astra think

Cheapest capable: Crons · Qwen tables · Astra analysis

MAA Action feeds Produce — revenue, profit, clicks decide the next recording
Cost order (pick-the-cheapest-capable-fleet-lane): local Qwen → Muse → everything else. Lanes are seats, not desk names.
Offline bulk text only: transcript triage, first drafts, MAA/GCT first
passes. Trenton's seat on the Macs. No browser, no logins, no
Muse Maximum is about 3B Muse tokens per week. Non-frontier volume: inbox, calendar, bookings,
Google/Meta chores, watch-and-ping, volume monitoring. Do not buy more Muse.
Astra / Dot (experimental; a human or a fresh ChatGPT task checks critical work) · Kimi and Codex crons already live · Grok desks for
judgment, publishing calls, routing (short turns) · any other seat — Cursor cloud, Claude Fleet, the rest — keeps the work already assigned
Named seats — do not invent agents
Tools on the line, not seats: Zoom recordings · Descript · jennifer A- grader · $1/day boosting. Handoff places: Drive · GitHub issue · Basecamp (Claude Fleet only) · Buzz (Monday MAA catch-up).
Badges are monograms, not official marks. If a later revision adds a vendor mark, use a permissive source such as Simple Icons (CC0) and note the license here. Dashed gold ring = experimental seat.

Seat picker: standards/pick-the-cheapest-capable-fleet-lane.md (merged 2026-10-01). Factory split per station: skills/content-factory/references/fleet-orchestration.md. Desk names confirmed against the live fleet registry on 2026-10-01.
Locked names: Plumbing (before) · Produce · Process · Post · Promote · Perform/MAA (after). Do not rename.
